title: Berlin budget — actual spending 2024
basis: Cash (cameral) actuals from Berlin's audited 2024 annual account (Abgeordnetenhaus Drucksache 19/2681), whole Berlin budget including boroughs.
method: Geometric word-level extraction from the rotated function table (pages 79–88), triple-validated: visual read of all group rows and the total on 300 DPI renders, cent-exact child-to-parent sums, and full row arithmetic. English names are editorial translations.
